block.moss_tts.workflow: Synthesize speech locally with MOSS-TTS-v1.5. Prepare the model, codec and Python environment first. The voice reference is optional. Each request produces a complete file.
block.moss_tts.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.moss_tts.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.moss_tts.invalid_config: Check the MOSS-TTS-v1.5 settings and limits.
block.moss_tts.model.title: MOSS-TTS-v1.5
block.moss_tts.model.description: Generate complete speech files locally with MOSS-TTS-v1.5 and an optional voice reference.
block.moss_tts.help_asset_directory: Prepare the pinned 24.1 GB model/codecs first. Runtime verifies local files and never downloads.
block.moss_tts.help_environment_python: Dedicated Linux Python 3.12 with the pinned dependencies. Empty uses the app interpreter only if compatible; nothing installs automatically.
block.moss_tts.help_language: Auto or one of 31 languages declared by MOSS v1.5. Actual pronunciation quality depends on the model and input.
block.moss_tts.help_reference_audio: Optional finalized local clip: 0.5–30 seconds, at most 32 MiB. Without it the model selects a voice. Use only a voice you may reproduce.
block.moss_tts.help_device: CUDA recommended; no silent CPU fallback. CPU requires float32 and substantial RAM. The model/codec load anew for each request.
block.moss_tts.help_precision: Bfloat16 on supported CUDA, or float32. The codec stays float32. CPU plus bfloat16 is refused explicitly.
block.moss_tts.help_format: Complete Ogg/Opus at 48 kHz or PCM WAV at 24 kHz. No direct live stream port.
block.moss_tts.help_output_directory: Empty uses this node’s persistent audio directory. Unique names, no overwrites or automatic deletion.
block.moss_tts.help_target_duration_sec: Optional duration conditioning, not an exact-length guarantee. Use 0 or 0.08 seconds up to the maximum audio duration.
block.moss_tts.help_max_audio_sec: Reject the entire result above this limit, including all audio regions. Never crop and label incomplete speech complete.
block.moss_tts.help_max_text_chars: Reject oversized text. The combined text and reference tokens must also fit the model’s context window.
block.moss_tts.help_max_new_tokens: Budget for combined text/audio autoregressive steps. Both audio end and assistant EOS must be present; exhaustion publishes nothing.
block.moss_tts.help_max_segments: Allow multiple complete audio regions. They are decoded separately in order; no region is silently discarded.
block.moss_tts.help_text_temperature: Official text-channel sampling temperature. Zero selects greedy decoding; not a voice or emotion selector.
block.moss_tts.help_text_top_k: Candidate text-token count. Zero disables this filter.
block.moss_tts.help_audio_temperature: Official audio-code sampling temperature. Zero selects greedy decoding.
block.moss_tts.help_audio_top_k: Candidate audio-code count. Zero disables this filter.
block.moss_tts.help_audio_repetition_pen: Official audio-token repetition control. Default 1; not a guarantee against repeated words.
block.moss_tts.help_threads: Bound native CPU parallelism in the owned inference process.
block.moss_tts.help_timeout_sec: Includes verification, loading, inference, encoding and publication. Maximum 240 seconds for managed execution.
block.moss_tts.help_memory_limit_mib: Optional Linux virtual-address ceiling: 0 disables it, otherwise at least 4096 MiB. CUDA reserves large virtual ranges. Not a RAM reservation.
block.moss_tts.help_min_available_ram_mi: Default 32 GiB. CPU also requires float32 weights plus a margin; CUDA checks free VRAM. These checks do not reserve memory.
block.moss_tts.help_max_pending: Active Runtime only. Zero rejects new text while busy. Interrupt stops the current job and clears earlier pending requests.
